column1: # name<TAB>arguments (shell words, run in this directory; "< file" = stdin). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 dustmasker 1.0.0 on ws (env_blast), 2026-11-12, ad-RG-K-1.
# help_xml (-xmlhelp, line RG item E2x): env_blast on ws, 2026-11-13 (ad-RG-E-5, line RG item E2 probe).

# -infmt blastdb: the databases in db/ were made by NCBI makeblastdb 2.17.0 from in/ (basic, deflines -> defl, nruns, ambig, short, protfirst -> prot, more_defl -parse_seqids -> mdefl_ps); @CWD@ in the expected text is this directory.

# OID ranges of an alias file (db/oidr.nal: DBLIST basic, FIRST_OID 2, LAST_OID 3): NCBI's CMaskBDBReader reads every OID of the volumes (GetNumOIDs), the range leaves none out. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-2.

# -conffile (line RG item E1 on dev: the command line's application start loads it in place of dustmasker.ini): conf/blastdb.ini sets [BLAST] BLASTDB=db, conf/malformed.ini has a line without '='. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-2.

# An alias value that NCBI cannot convert (db/lenbad.nal: DBLIST basic, LENGTH abc): NCBI reports the CStringException, exit status 3. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-2 (review 2 F6).
# -dryrun (line RG item E1b on dev): the arguments are read, nothing runs. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-2.

# Alias values that only a search reads differently (review 2 of K1, F5): db/len0.nal (DBLIST basic, LENGTH 0), db/nseqneg.nal (NSEQ -5), db/firstbig.nal (FIRST_OID 3000000000), and the ranged db/oidr with another name (db/short). NCBI's CMaskBDBReader reads every OID with GetBioseq, as without the alias file. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-3.

# id_del_* (a DEL byte in a -parse_seqids id: # and error 803.7 in the serial formats, as it is in interval; RG DECISIONS K4-1) frozen 2026-11-14 by ad-RG-K-10 with the local official NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 release; in/id_del.fa is the review's du_lcl.fa (remaining-gaps-20261112/K/k4/review/probe/in).

# Database sequences without a title whose taxid the taxonomy database names (line RG item T5): ../db_search/t5 (make_t5.py there), its taxonomy database ../seqdb/taxdb/t5 on the search path of conf/t5.ini. NCBI makes each title from the name (CDeflineGenerator::x_SetTitleFromBioSrc: the name without white space at its ends, its first letter upper-cased; an empty title for a taxid without a name). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-14, ad-RG-T5-1.

# Taxids of other encodings (fix 2 of line RG item T5c): ../db_search/t5/ntx_app42 and ntx_sx9 (make_t5.py --taxid-only), whose first record's taxid NCBI's ReadInt4 reads as makeblastdb's (the application INTEGER tag 0x42, nine content bytes of sign extension). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-15, T5c fix 2.

# order_* (a DEL byte in a -parse_seqids id of a sequence with 300 masked intervals, each writing the id in the serial formats; order_int_ps reads the input as the reader cases do: NCBI's 803.7 messages fall among the document's bytes where its output buffer (4096 bytes; back limit text 80, binary 0) handed them out; ncbi/<name>.merged is NCBI's 2>&1 stream of a run of its own; M4a-1b part 6) frozen 2026-11-14 by ad-M4a-3 with the local official release.

# A damaged taxonomy database (line RG item T5b): ../db_search/t5b (make_t5b.py there), the taxonomy database ../seqdb/taxdb/<variant> on the search path of conf/t5b_<variant>.ini. NCBI's GetBioseq looks up each positive taxid of every sequence it reads, whatever the format: the texts of opening a damaged database once, at the first lookup (Error: Error: Tax database file has wrong magic number., Error: SeqDB: Taxid metadata indicates ...), and the offset error of the last entry at each lookup that misses the volume's 256-slot cache; exit status 0. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-14, ad-RG-T5-4.

# A record of taxdb.btd that reaches past NCBI's mapping of the file (line RG item T5b fix 2): the taxonomy databases ../db_search/t5b/taxdb/<variant> (make_t5b.py --taxdb) on the search path of conf/t5b_<variant>.ini. kingdom_past_page: 9606's record runs past the mapping after its third tab (its names are NCBI's, a title made from them too); names_past_page: 9606's record lies wholly past it, and the loads, whose names no output writes, go on as NCBI's (a title made from them is refused, taxdb_tool_texts.rs). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-15, the T5b fix 2 subagent of ad-RG-T5-5.

# OIDLIST (line RG, series D, D1b-1, 2026-11-21): the alias files of ../db_search/oidlist (make_oidlist.py). The reader reads every OID of the volumes, the OIDs the list leaves out too; a missing OID list file stops it before the first sequence, at the constructor's scan and, under NSEQ and LENGTH, at the reader's first use of the OID list. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-21, ad-RG-D-26.

# The Seq-id that seqloc_* and maskinfo_* print, of a sequence whose first Seq-id is not the one of its handle (GetAccessSeq_id_Handle: a gi, else a Textseq-id, else the first; line NP item M5c review, NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws, 2026-11-21)

# A gi of 0 is not a gi for GetAccessSeq_id_Handle (IsGi asks for a non-zero packed value): the Seq-id that seqloc_* and maskinfo_* print (line NP M5 final review B1, NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws, 2026-11-21)
